env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME PST, acme_pst. Each retailer that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_pst for the prefix ACME PST

env.name: PST_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix your app's names in the retailer's iVendNext start with, in capitals: the --prefix you gave start.py (for example ACME PST).
env.purpose: Filled in for you: the prefix your app's names start with, like ACME PST

env.name: PST_PAGE_URL
env.about: Where the processing room's stations reach this service's page (https://production-station.example.app). Each station's link points there.
env.purpose: Your service's web address, where the stations open their page
